body.claim: With public-key encryption, anyone can encrypt a message, but only the holder of the paired private key can decrypt it.
body.why: Each person has a pair of keys. The public key can be openly distributed without compromising security, and the private key must stay secret. The security of the whole system depends on the private key never becoming known to anyone else.

probes.question: Which key can decrypt a message encrypted with your public key?
True or false: the public key must be kept secret.

claims.claim: Security depends on the private key never becoming known to anyone else
